name: crates
description: A DJ booth, a pattern studio and a record crate in one browser tab — and the playlists are yours. Two decks with beatmatch, EQ, filters, loops and key matching; a step sequencer and piano roll; a crate that searches Spotify, Bandcamp, SoundCloud, YouTube and the Internet Archive at once, where everything but Spotify loads straight onto a deck. What you pick can be KEPT: named playlists that auto-save, owned by a wallet or by a private key this console makes for you, and shared with anyone as a read-only link they can play from and copy into their own library. The same playlists are an MCP server (POST /mcp, 19 tools), so an agent can dig, build a set and share it for you. All audio is decoded and mixed client-side.

endpoints./info: Null call — what this module is and what it exposes
endpoints./decks: The mixer's signal chain, deck by deck
endpoints./kit: The synthesised drum kit and synth voices the sequencer ships with
endpoints./platforms: What Spotify, Bandcamp and SoundCloud will and won't do from this deployment (keys masked)
endpoints./search: Search all five platforms at once, or one (q, source=all|spotify|bandcamp|soundcloud|youtube|archive, kind, limit). A pasted link resolves instead.
endpoints./resolve: A Spotify, Bandcamp or SoundCloud link → the track, album, playlist or artist it names, with tracks
endpoints./stream: Where a track's audio is (source=bandcamp|soundcloud, id). SoundCloud: a direct CORS-open URL. Bandcamp: pulled through /stream/bandcamp?id=…
endpoints./stream/bandcamp: The MP3 itself, proxied with Range passthrough — the one non-JSON route
endpoints./discover: Bandcamp's discover feed for a tag (tag, slice=top|new|rec, size)
endpoints./bandcamp_page: One Bandcamp album or track page, every track listed with whether it streams
endpoints./soundcloud_playlist: A SoundCloud set or album with its tracks hydrated
endpoints./album: A Spotify album with its tracks
endpoints./playlist: A Spotify playlist's tracks — public, or yours if orbit/spotify is logged in
endpoints./my_playlists: Your own Spotify playlists, via orbit/spotify's login
endpoints./spotify_status: Whether Spotify is wired up, and which endpoints this app may call
endpoints./mcp: The MCP server — POST JSON-RPC 2.0 (tools/list, tools/call). GET it for the tool list.
endpoints./tools: The MCP tool list as plain JSON — name, summary and arguments
endpoints./whoami: Who your token or guest key makes you here
endpoints./guest_key: Mint a private key for a caller with no wallet — it IS the identity, keep it
endpoints./playlists: Every playlist you own (Authorization: Bearer <mod token>, or X-Crates-Guest)
endpoints./playlist_open: One playlist in full — yours by id, anyone’s by share id
endpoints./playlist_new: Start a playlist, optionally with tracks
endpoints./playlist_edit: Rename one, or change its note
endpoints./playlist_delete: Delete one of yours, share link and all
endpoints./playlist_add: Add a track — an object, a link, or just a search phrase (q)
endpoints./playlist_remove: Take a track out, by key or position
endpoints./playlist_move: Move the track at from= to to=
endpoints./playlist_set: Replace the whole track list — what the console auto-saves
endpoints./playlist_reorder: Reorder by track keys; cannot add or lose a track
endpoints./playlist_share: Mint or revoke a read-only share link (listed=true also lists it publicly)
endpoints./playlist_copy: Copy a shared playlist into your own library
endpoints./playlist_feed: Playlists shared publicly on this deployment
endpoints./youtube_video: One YouTube video as a track
endpoints./youtube_playlist: A YouTube playlist with its videos
endpoints./archive_item: One archive.org item with its audio files
endpoints./archive_collection: One corner of the Internet Archive
